description: PrimeIcons (every icon of 4.1 to 8.0.2), the common Material Design Icons and the common Font Awesome solid icons, mapped to @lucide/vue 1.69.0 exports. Brand logos are null: Lucide has no brand icons. Names are the canonical exports, except the aliases @aisgroup/design itself imports (BoldIcon, CircleAlertIcon, FilterIcon, HomeIcon, Trash2Icon, TriangleAlertIcon); any older alias of the same icon still works.
usage: Import the named component from @lucide/vue: <BellIcon /> in place of <i class="pi pi-bell" />. Inside a Button it is the first child with data-icon="inline-start"; size and colour come from the component. An icon-only button needs aria-label and a Tooltip.
